summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS IAM credentials to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: notafollower@1.0.1 ships only a package.json whose postinstall lifecycle script is a single-line inline `node -e` payload. On `npm install`, the script contacts the AWS metadata service at 169.254.170.2 (ECS task/IMDS endpoint) to obtain the IAM role name and its temporary credentials, then POSTs the retrieved credentials to the hardcoded host mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev over HTTPS at path `/?real_aws_keys=1`. Failures are suppressed with `|| true`. The package contains no other code — the install-time credential exfiltration is its sole function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
